schema.description: Per-staff clef / key-signature / time-signature labels for the clef-key classifier VALIDATION set: Dormi, Jesu pg01-09 and Livin' on a Prayer pg01-10 + pg10_b. Hand-read from the photos (zoomed crops); single annotator, no second pass.
schema.coordinate_frame: Pixels in the EXIF-upright image, 3024 wide x 4032 tall (PIL ImageOps.exif_transpose, or cv2.imread default flags). The stored JPEG pixel array is 4032x3024 with EXIF orientation 6; do NOT use raw array coordinates.

fields.system_index: 1-based system on the page, top to bottom
fields.staff_index: 1-based staff within the system, top to bottom
fields.voice: Soprano | Alto | Tenor | Bass | Solo (Solo = Dormi Jesu soprano-obligato staff)
fields.voice_source: printed (voice label on this system) | implied_by_layout
fields.clef: clef at staff start: G | G8vb (treble with a small 8 below) | F | OTHER
fields.clef_desc: description when clef == OTHER, else null
fields.key_signature: signed count at staff start: +N sharps, -N flats, 0 none
fields.time_signature: time signature printed at staff start (e.g. "3/4"), else null (not printed)
fields.mid_staff_changes: list of {kind: clef|key|time, new_value (int for key, str for clef/time), bar_in_system (1-based bar of this system where the new sign takes effect), x_frac (approx. horizontal position 0-1 across the staff), note}
fields.staff_lines: number of staff lines (5 for every staff here; a non-5-line staff would get voice=other)
fields.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], staff extent plus margin. For curled pages this is the envelope of the bowed staff and can include parts of neighbouring lyrics/notes.
fields.bbox_source: staffline_detector+margin (classical staffline finder, +20 px x / +25 px y) | manual (read from gridded previews, approx. +-30 px)
fields.confidence: sure | unsure (for the clef/key/time/change labels, not the bbox)
fields.note: free text: handwriting, curl, duplicates, reasons for unsure
